anchor.section: Attaching Fragile Textiles to Support Fabrics — Self-couching stitch

evidence.note: CCI says a self-couching stitch secures torn, frayed or weak textile areas to a new support fabric. This is a modern conditional conservation relation, not medieval practice, a current textile, thread, support, tool, skill, repair success, strength or item identity.

anchor.section: Research on Leather Dressings, treatment-report quotation beginning ‘The stitching attaching the sides to the sole’

evidence.note: NPS records a shoe in which weakened and broken stitching attaching sides to the sole was followed by separation of the parts. The candidate is limited to a stitched leather assembly; it is not evidence that every leather object is stitched, nor of a current object, cause, load, repair, durability, medieval practice or outcome.

anchor.section: Overview, paragraph beginning ‘Water that has fuel’; Ways to make water safe — Boiling

evidence.note: CDC says water containing fuel or toxic chemicals is not made drinkable by boiling or household treatment. The bounded candidate is epistemic: boiling alone does not establish drinkability for those named contaminant classes; it does not assert a universal physical non-removal result for every substance or treatment. No contamination, water source, treatment event, drinking permission or health outcome.

claim_localizations.runtime_text: Стежки могут закреплять порванный, осыпающийся или ослабленный участок текстиля на поддерживающей ткани. Это не устанавливает текстиль, нить, поддержку, инструмент, навык, историческую практику, прочность или результат ремонта в конкретной сцене.

Stitching can secure a torn, frayed, or weak textile area to a support textile. This establishes no textile, thread, support, tool, skill, historical practice, strength, or repair result in a concrete scene.

В кожаном изделии, части которого соединены стежками, разрушение соединяющих стежков может привести к разделению частей. Это не устанавливает изделие, тип стежков, состояние шва, нагрузку, причину разрушения, ремонт, долговечность, историческую практику или исход в конкретной сцене.

In a leather assembly whose components are joined by stitching, failure of the joining stitches can separate the components. This establishes no object, stitch type, seam condition, load, failure cause, repair, durability, historical practice, or outcome in a concrete scene.

Одно кипячение само по себе не устанавливает пригодность для питья воды с топливом или токсичными химическими примесями. Это не утверждает универсальную невозможность удаления любого вещества и не устанавливает загрязнение, источник воды, обработку, разрешение на питьё или исход для здоровья в конкретной сцене.

Boiling alone does not establish the drinkability of water containing fuel or toxic chemicals. This does not assert universal impossibility of removing every substance and establishes no contamination, water source, treatment event, drinking permission, or health outcome in a concrete scene.
